title: SAGE multi-sensor digital-twin fusion stress campaign (public aggregate)

campaign.runtime_class: unsupervised multi-sensor fusion world-sim with optional GPU reconstruction
campaign.purpose: Exercise a multi-fidelity digital-twin sensor network under transport latency, dropout, and clock skew so sensor-suite decisions can be compared before hardware is committed.

top_suite_classes_high_latency.suite_class: vibro-acoustic + gap + coolant pressure + dynamometer family
accelerometer + eddy gap + rotary encoder + hall + thermal family
coolant flow + rotary encoder + hall + microphone + tachometer + thermal cam family

what_is_real: Executable multi-sensor world model with asynchronous event fusion
Declared latency, dropout, jitter, and multi-hop network stress
Comparable suite ranking under the same synthetic latent world
Hash-bound public aggregate and provenance labels for review
what_transfers_today: Method for ranking sensor suites under network latency before hardware spend
Practice of keeping SIMULATED evidence separate from OBSERVED measurements
Decision-support use of twin outputs behind a closed physical gate
what_does_not_transfer_yet: Field-validated accuracy on a specific customer machine
Guaranteed cycle-time, tool-life, or surface-quality improvement

method_summary.latent_world: Coupled reduced-order machining state (force, wear, chatter, temperature, deflection, coolant) with regime switching
method_summary.sensors: Random suites of 3–16 sensor classes drawn from a 26-class catalog with rate, noise, dropout, and clock skew
method_summary.network: One to three hops from sensor to fusion node with queuing delay multiplied under stress
method_summary.fusion: Fixed-rate fusion ticks with last-value hold and explicit staleness features
scores: Latent identifiability versus hidden truth (evaluation only)

limitations: Entire campaign is SIMULATED; observed physical samples equal zero
Suite ranking uses a small number of suite instances per class (n≈4 for leaders)
Identifiability is against the synthetic latent world, not shop-floor ground truth
Optional GPU reconstruction path is research-only and not a product authority model
Public JSON is aggregate-only; raw episode corpora and training recipes are not published
